chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from al-Husayn ibn Yazid from Isma'il ibn Muslim al-Sukuni from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: Ali (peace be upon him) said:

There is not a day that passes by a son of Adam except that the day says to him: O son of Adam! I am a new day, and I am a witness over you. So say what is good during me and do what is good during me, and I will testify for you on the Day of Resurrection; for indeed you will never see me again after it.

key_terms.شهيد: Witness -- the day testifies on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.يوم القيامة: Day of Resurrection, when deeds are accounted for
key_terms.يوم جديد: A new day -- each day personified as a unique witness

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about each day being a witness over us?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) personified each passing day as a conscious witness that speaks to every human being: "I am new, and I watch over you. Speak good and act good within me, and I shall testify in your favor on the Day of Resurrection -- for once I pass, you will never see me again." This powerful exhortation, delivered to encourage immediate righteous action, reminds the listener that time is irreversible and each day is an unrepeatable opportunity for good deeds.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
